name: Starfallen: Strength
source:
Welcome to the Sky Ward, a fortress built with the purpose of discovering the mysteries of magic on the pangea Aelyria.

As Lennon and Petra, a pair of cousins who've helped establish the Sky Ward as a global power, explore the Sky Ward while unveiling the mysteries of the world and within your own fortress. 

Between pyromaniacs threatening to burn down the grand library, a traitor within your midst, and a great evil that you've yet to face brewing on the horizon.

How will you choose to navigate this, and get closer to the other members of the Sky Ward, when they could very well be responsible for its downfall?

[From [url=https://meant-to-bee-studios.itch.io/starfallen-strength]itch.io[/url]]
